item.description:
Today - Open the island with nothing playing to see the date, your next event and, if you turn it on, the weather where you are. Turn on the weather in Settings › Activities › Today.
Screenshots to the shelf - New screenshots and screen recordings can land on the shelf by themselves, ready to drag into any app or AirDrop. Turn it on in Settings › Activities › Shelf and choose your screenshots folder (usually the Desktop).

System Monitor - CPU, memory, network, battery health and disk in the island, with graphs of the last few minutes, your local IP address and a speed test. Turn it on in Settings › Activities. - Quiet by default: the notch stays clear until the CPU stays busy, memory runs short or a big download runs. Open the island, or press the gauge button from any activity, to see the panel. - Alerts when the CPU stays busy for two minutes, macOS runs short of memory, or the disk is nearly full.
Fixes - The mirror no longer stays black the first time you open it.

Claude Code, clearer - The expanded island now shows Claude's last few steps on their own full-width lines, so nothing is cut off. - Each Claude session in the list names its project. - A Claude timer no longer keeps running after you interrupt Claude, or when a turn ends on an error. Lintel now tells you why it stopped, for example "rate limit reached".
Lighter - The working spinner uses about a tenth of the CPU it did.
